answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a sunk entry tax of 120 POA before it can earn, a toll to enter the meadow. The tax is burned, never refunded, and a raven audit samples 1 in 20 identities each epoch to check the payment receipt. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 12,000 POA for 100 shares of one fixed pool, while one honest agent pays 120 POA once and keeps a full share at the oasis of steady work. Forgery costs more than it earns.
